scope: The root exports both true LDP register pairs and the real repeated STPs on the same actual kernel memcpy state. Imported bit-level memory reads identify each64bit half of a native16byte read with the corresponding read8 under wrapping64. Both actual LDPs and both pair modes load original physical source words into X6/X7 and X12/X13; the second LDP preserves the first pair. TwoLoads reached-state views derive by reflexivity from its existing steps. The imported checked-write body supplies actual memory, initialized ranges, ordered write events and full native frames. Both captured STP instructions implement two ordered write8 operations or one high++low write16. One original16byte writable-range premise derives all actual write results and initialized profiles. The first STP derives the second address minus16, profile, rights, no-error, code/PC and fetch; both stores retain actual stored/final witnesses and concrete imported memory-state views. complete_from_loads consumes the SAME TwoLoads witness and reached-state equality, derives current facts and original loaded words, and returns one store witness whose two real event lists repeat those words. Final PC=origin+52 derives actual RET fetch, with every register/environment preserved. Final physical memory readback/source16byte correspondence, actual RET/LR, BTI/live alternatives and remaining helper/source/global/universal domains/recount continue before M6.
